    European Space Agency: Elevating the Future of Europe

    [ Euclid ]
    [ Universe ]

    Euclid lays the foundation for its best-ever 3D map of the Universe

    The European Space Agency’s Euclid mission has released its first major batch of data. With this release, which captures the light of more than a billion objects and covers an area of sky as big as 9500 full Moons, ESA’s dark Universe detective lays the foundation for its largest-ever 3D map of the cosmos.

    explore
    [ Meteorological missions ]
    [ meteosat third generation ]

    MTG-I2 weather satellite delivers first images

    The Meteosat Third Generation (MTG) mission’s second Imager satellite has delivered its first images, showing weather patterns over Europe and Africa.

    explore
    [ Space Safety ]
    [ Hera ]

    Hera’s first close-up view of Didymos asteroids

    The European Space Agency’s Hera mission for planetary defence has acquired its first close-up of the Didymos binary asteroid system. NASA’s DART spacecraft impacted the smaller Dimorphos asteroid on 26 September 2022 – but this image gives a novel view of its adjacent parent asteroid.

    explore
    [ News ]
    [ Latest news ]

    A call to boost European space exploration

    The Call sets out a shared vision for strengthening Europe's role in human and robotic space exploration and provides political guidance for preparations ahead of the Intermediate Ministerial Meeting in Rome on 15 December.

    Member States

    ESA has 23 Member States. The national bodies responsible for space in these countries sit on ESA’s governing Council. Canada also sits on the Council and takes part in some projects under a Cooperation Agreement. Cyprus, Slovakia, Latvia and Lithuania are Associate Members. Three other EU states have Cooperation Agreements with ESA: Bulgaria, Croatia and Malta.
